title: Canonical change of compactification candidate on bounded-below etale origin
statement:
Let $u$ be a universe, $\Lambda:\operatorname{Type}(u+1)$ a finite commutative ring, $X,Y$ schemes in universe $u$ [def-pc-scheme], and $f:X\to Y$ a quasi-compact morphism. Supply compactifications $c=(j_c,r_c)$ and $d=(j_d,r_d)$ of $f$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Let $\mathcal O_X=\mathcal D^+_{\mathrm{et}}(X,\Lambda)$ be the full bounded-below etale-origin category with its underlying-object inclusion $\iota_X$ [def-sf-etale-origin-subcategory]. For $a=c,d$, let $F_a^p=Rr_{a,p,*}j_{a,p,!}$ be the ordinary fixed-$\Lambda$ pro-etale compact-support candidate [def-weil-compact-support-candidate] and $F_a^e$ its etale counterpart [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. Write $C_T=\nu_T^*$ for termwise derived site comparison [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback], and $\Phi_X:D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)\simeq\mathcal O_X$ for its corestriction. Let $B_a:F_a^p C_X\xrightarrow{\sim}C_YF_a^e$ be the canonical compact-support site comparison from the counit-normalized proper mate and adjoint open-extension comparison [def-sf-compact-support-site-comparison-construction], and let $\rho^e_{c,d}:F_c^e\xrightarrow{\sim}F_d^e$ be the canonical etale common-refinement comparison [lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons], on bounded-below inputs. Define
$$\theta_{c,d}:F_c^p\iota_X\xrightarrow{\sim}F_d^p\iota_X$$
as the fully faithful inverse image under precomposition with $\Phi_X$ of
$$F_c^pC_X\xrightarrow{B_c}C_YF_c^e\xrightarrow{C_Y(\rho^e_{c,d})}C_YF_d^e\xrightarrow{B_d^{-1}}F_d^pC_X.$$
This specifies the comparison on all morphisms in the full etale-origin category, without an arbitrary isomorphism choice or any separatedness assumption on structure maps to a field.

def towerCandidateComparison [Finite Λ] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    [QuasiCompact f] (c d : Compactification f) :
    (DerivedCategory.plusEtaleOrigin (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).ι ⋙
      rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) c ≅
    (DerivedCategory.plusEtaleOrigin (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).ι ⋙
      rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) d
